title.rendered: Brides Just Want To Have Fun

content.rendered:
Some weddings are sophisticated, some are a lot of fun and some are really cool, laid back and classy…. We work on your wedding the way YOU want your big day to be….

We know how much work goes into these custom dances!

IF you have an idea for something special for your wedding please let Chris know….

[youtube https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1MuFXSyQe9A]

Got questions? Call Chris of California Disc Jockeys on 415-350-5474
